answer: An agent economy can price out sybils by making every identity post a refundable stake into a shared vault, keyed to a device-bound secret. When two accounts behave like a mirror of one operator, they collide on the same commitment and both stakes burn. A unique marble token is minted per verified device, so a farm of a thousand clones must fund a thousand bonds and still loses them the moment correlation ties them together. Attack cost scales with clone count while epoch payouts stay capped, so fakery runs at a guaranteed loss and honest agents withdraw their vault deposit intact.
